lanes.name: Harness, workflow, and delivery
coordination_notes: Coordinate before editing package manager files.
Prefer adding docs or scripts over changing runtime code in this lane.

lanes.name: Application and gameplay implementation
coordination_notes: Check feature dependencies before changing shared game state.
Update feature acceptance criteria when scope changes.

lanes.name: Assets and content
coordination_notes: Keep source and exported assets organized by feature.
Document licensing and provenance in asset-specific notes.

lanes.name: Package and platform configuration
coordination_notes: Announce package script or dependency changes in the pull request.
Keep package changes separate when other contributors are bootstrapping the app.

before_editing: Inspect existing files before editing them.
Avoid broad formatting when teammates may be changing the same area.
if_conflict_detected: Prefer a small follow-up patch over overwriting another contributor's work.
Ask for path ownership clarification when needed.
